annotations.title: Web page to Markdown: any URL

description: Web page to Markdown: give a public URL and get the page's main content as clean Markdown for an LLM, with headings, links, lists, tables and code blocks kept and navigation, ads and scripts removed, up to 100,000 characters; static HTML, Markdown and text pages. Bot walls, empty pages and errors are never charged. Use to put an article, documentation page or blog post into a prompt, a RAG index or an agent's notes. Example: url=https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: Returned representation: markdown (default), text, or both

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of body text to return (500-100000, default 20000)

section.description: Optional exact visible HTML ID within the main content, 1-500 characters

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to convert
